capabilities: Browse, search and edit Markdown notes in a three-pane panel
Sync notes and images with the Getnote cloud
Import voice-recorder cards over Bluetooth or Wi-Fi
Manage tags, backlinks, outlines, history snapshots and trash
Export and import zip archive bundles
disambiguation: Not a cloud client: notes live as local Markdown in the vault and everything works offline; Getnote cloud sync and recorder-card import are optional extras.
extras: Desktop only for recorder import; starts a loopback HTTP service on 127.0.0.1 for panel assets and OAuth; no telemetry; Getnote cloud API is non-public and may change; UI in Chinese, English and Dutch.
intentEvidence: This is the Obsidian port of dsh-getnote (the DeepSeek Harness version).
problem: Users of the Getnote (得到大脑) note service cannot keep that workflow inside Obsidian: no local three-pane browser, offline search, cloud sync or recorder-card import for their notes.

relations.evidence: This is the Obsidian port of dsh-getnote (the DeepSeek Harness version).

requires.name: Python 3.10+ with bleak (voice recorder import only)
Getnote Open API key (API Key, Client ID, Grant ID)

summary: Local-first port of the Getnote (得到大脑) note workflow: a three-pane Markdown panel for offline browse, search, edit, backlinks, plus optional cloud sync.
